children: Braiin entered a non-binding term sheet for a phased acquisition of Marut Drones, beginning with a majority stake. The proposed deal value is approximately $40M; completion is subject to due diligence, definitive agreements and approvals.
The announced value includes upfront consideration, performance-linked earn-outs and growth capital; final terms remain subject to conditions.
The phased transaction would give Braiin control, with the remaining stake acquired later in performance-linked phases.
There is no completed deal; due diligence, definitive agreements and regulatory and third-party approvals remain outstanding.
The proposed acquisition would add certified drone platforms and manufacturing capability, avoiding a buildout from scratch.
Marut has over 100 dealers and 7 pilot schools
The existing distribution and training network could support Braiin's planned entry into India, subject to deal completion.

This is a proposed strategic expansion of Braiin's existing drone business into India, not a completed transaction. Definitive agreements, satisfactory due diligence, the audit and required Indian regulatory and third-party approvals must follow for the acquisition to close.
from Braiin Limited distributed by GlobeNewswire.
